instruct: A clear young woman's voice in a medium-LOW register, bright but poised, quick-minded and confident; excitement held on a steady frame, like a librarian who can command a room when she needs to; crisp diction, warm undertone; noticeably lower-pitched than a typical young voice, never squeaky.

text: Oh! Oh, you have to see this — I found it on the third shelf, exactly where it wanted to be. Take it, it's yours to borrow — just remember to bring it back!
